Remark
[Geometric limits and incompleteness] ↗ def:geometric-limit

Conditions (1) and (2a) in the definition above also appear in the definition in the case of complete limits. It is Condition (2b) that is extra in this incomplete case. It says that once $k$ is sufficiently large then the image $\varphi _\ell (V_k)$ contains all points satisfying two conditions: they are at most a given bounded distance from $x_\ell $, and also they are at least a fixed distance from the boundary of $U_\ell $.
